'''''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption''''', originally titled '''''Tales of the Jedi: The Redemption of Ulic Qel-Droma''''',<ref name="Insider35">{{InsiderCite|35|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth}}</ref> is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].

It is the final miniseries in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] comic series, and it ran from [[July 22]], [[1998]] to [[November 25]], 1998, following the release of ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' in [[1997]].
